subject.title: [Feature]: Proposal: Restructure VISION.md as a decision framework for humans and AI PR review

question: Should OpenClaw make VISION.md a thesis-led human/AI PR decision framework, or keep AI-auditor criteria in a separate review-policy surface?
rationale: The documentation gap is clear, but the product thesis wording and the document boundary for automated-review criteria require maintainer intent before a safe rewrite.

options.title: Accept narrow VISION framework
options.body: Add a concise thesis, reusable gut-check questions, and rationale-backed guardrails to VISION.md, then align contribution surfaces only where criteria change.

options.title: Split auditor policy out
options.body: Keep VISION.md as product principles and put detailed AI-auditor criteria in a dedicated review-policy document linked from contributor guidance.

options.title: Decline the rewrite
options.body: Leave VISION.md as a lighter roadmap guardrail and close the request if maintainers do not want it to become a review decision contract.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow VISION framework
recommendation.body: Add a concise thesis, reusable gut-check questions, and rationale-backed guardrails to VISION.md, then align contribution surfaces only where criteria change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the strongest current VISION.md and product-direction trail and is the likely person to decide whether this belongs in VISION.md.
